premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An aging healer notices their hands shake during delicate work.

choices.label: Continue with supervision and adapt techniques.
Teach an apprentice and move into consultation.
Hide the problem and risk a serious error.
Retire from procedures but remain a valued mentor.

outcome.name: Ending
outcome.text: The decision may restore confidence, create a new apprenticeship, change profession or duties, or expose a preventable error. An honest admission can still bring accountability; concealment may appear to work initially but create a delayed callback.
